g.text: Separate trace resets change actions, but amplify later weight movement

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: Same trained memory, three historical images and full native graph. All twelve conditions are shown.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: Δ L2 measures weight movement during image 3 across 7,835 plastic connections; it is not a loss or gradient.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: Six original controls reproduce. Frozen resets preserve recorded activity and memory. 36 observations / 1,800 bins audited.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: No fills, accounts or returns are recomputed here. Matching HOLD decisions do not mean matching neural trajectories.
